> StartupIndia.Law is the techno-legal advisory practice of Aashish (Aash) Gupta (Adv. Ashish Gupta), based in India with offices in Delhi-NCR and Mumbai, and direct reach into Silicon Valley.

## About Counsel & Leadership

Aashish (Aash) Gupta is the Director of StartupIndia.Law. He holds a Master of Laws (LL.M.) in Technology Law from the University of California, Berkeley School of Law (2012) and an engineering degree (B.Tech, Electronics & Telecommunication, 2004). He has cleared the US Patent Bar and is qualified to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).

He has nearly two decades of experience spanning:
- Intellectual property law (patents, trademarks, trade secrets, copyright)
- Technology transactions, transfer, and cross-border licensing
- Venture capital due diligence, cap table audits, and fund advisory
- Cross-border corporate structuring (India-US Delaware flips, Singapore holding structures)
- AI governance, algorithmic compliance, and digital asset regulation
- Startup entity architecture and investor negotiations

Previously, he was Director, IP Investment & Advisory Arm of Pendrell Corporation (NASDAQ: PCO) in Silicon Valley from 2012 to 2015, where he ran licensing programs covering roughly half the global mobile phone market and led due diligence on the acquisition of Nokia's memory business unit in Helsinki. Separately, he has advised on valuation strategy in the Apple v. Samsung patent dispute. He has held roles at Krishna & Saurastri Associates LLP (Partner) and Khaitan & Co. (Senior Associate).

- Patent Strategy and Global Portfolio Management
- IP Valuation and Technology Monetization

- Venture Due Diligence and Term Sheet Audits
- Cross-Border M&A and Foreign Investment Structuring

- Startup Incorporation and Entity Design (India, Delaware, Singapore)
